summary: Golden coverage and ADR-027 clause 4 version-decision verification. First ran the pinned native oracle on the pre-task tree (RenderGoldenTests Failed 0, Passed 15, Skipped 0, Total 15) and confirmed git status shows the 13 committed PNGs unmodified and the manifest diff a pure append, so every Small/Medium/Large golden byte, hash, and fingerprint still reproduces under the pinned renderer. Added two Extra Large golden fixtures (Extended RenderGoldenFixtures.Names and BuildRequest using the existing PositionPolicy helper at the default BottomLeft anchor): bottom-left-extra-large (TechnicalMetadata, the rgb-png inputs, 13,040 bytes, hash 3AFFB2E6CB345F5834D07ED1DFB13A3E1A2B52CA52203448A5FEE685CBE7E7F9, fingerprint A21E1D031E6C6F48C27A69EAE69CB19DB130EC4141608BE6748BB534382CD3E1) and full-rail-extra-large (FullRailMetadata, the full-rail inputs, 12,447 bytes, hash 26B96CD18E1BA3838A458E63D784FC77DE97A53ADBDB8D3A9E50593DEAF9FBDA, fingerprint 6E30E536B83D5285462E7E9753B68776AB8CF56035EF5D7F4BDFA8D61D18CF11). The PNGs and manifest entries were produced by a one-off throwaway generator kept outside the repo (/tmp/18.2/generator, deleted after use; no File.Write* path in the shipped golden test code), following the task 12.4 precedent. Extended RenderDeterminismTests.RepeatedRendersAreByteIdentical with bottom-left-extra-large; two separate generator processes produced byte-identical PNGs (cmp clean). The new manifest fingerprints differ from their Medium counterparts with all other inputs identical, and no version constant advanced (RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion stays 3, RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion stays 2; no source file is in the diff). Validation: build 0 warnings/0 errors; default suite Failed 0/Passed 1799/Skipped 64/Total 1863 (unchanged vs 18.1); forced-native full suite Failed 0/Passed 1884/Skipped 21/Total 1905; focused native golden oracle 0/17/0/17 (pre-task 0/15/0/15); focused native determinism 0/5/0/5; focused fingerprint/configuration 0/61/0/61. Three sensitivity probes (wrong manifest hash, mutated golden byte, removed golden PNG) each failed the new fixture case and the manifest-completeness fact (Failed 2, Passed 15, Total 17) and were reverted. Documentation: state.json 18.2 done + report path, PLANS.md checkbox, changelog entry; README/architecture/data-model were verified not stale (18.1 updated their Extra Large text; the normative G7 documentation is 18.3). render-docs-state reports up to date and check-docs.sh passed all nine sections on the tree before this report was persisted (after persistence only the agent-contract worker/reviewer pairing check is pending the orchestrator's implementation-reviewer report).

interpretations.question: Which new Extra Large fixture set to add (the task allowed a minimal-but-meaningful set and left the exact cases open).
interpretations.chosen: Two goldens at the default BottomLeft anchor: bottom-left-extra-large (TechnicalMetadata, identical to the Medium rgb-png inputs) and full-rail-extra-large (FullRailMetadata, identical to the Medium full-rail inputs). Each differs from an already-committed Medium golden only by the size, so the pair directly pins the 2.0 factor and provides the same-other-inputs fingerprint comparison; position and safe-area interactions are already covered by the 18.1 geometry tests and the 12.4 anchor/size goldens.
interpretations.basis: The task's suggested minimal set (one technical-metadata and one full-rail Extra Large golden), the existing PositionPolicy fixture pattern, and the requirement not to add redundant cases.
interpretations.impact: Two new committed PNGs and two manifest entries; the native golden and canonical cross-runtime theories gain two cases each, while the default suite totals are unchanged because the native theories remain one environment skip each.

interpretations.question: How to produce the committed PNGs and manifest entries with the generator kept outside the repository.
interpretations.chosen: A temporary console project under /tmp/18.2/generator that references the test project and invokes the internal fixture builder via reflection under the pinned native runtime, printing the exact hash/fingerprint values copied into the manifest; the project was deleted after use.
interpretations.basis: The task's explicit constraint that the generator stay outside the repo and the task 12.4 precedent that the shipped test code must gain no writer or auto-approval path.
interpretations.impact: The committed goldens were produced by a one-off process rather than a reproducible in-repo command (recorded as a limitation); the shipped golden tests remain read-only over the artifacts and fail closed.
